hooks.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); if [ -x "$r/.agents/hooks/tms-sync-reminder.sh" ]; then exec "$r/.agents/hooks/tms-sync-reminder.sh"; elif [ -x "$HOME/.agents/hooks/tms-sync-reminder.sh" ]; then exec "$HOME/.agents/hooks/tms-sync-reminder.sh"; fi; printf "{}"'

Stop.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); if [ -x "$r/.agents/hooks/tms-doc-sync-stop.sh" ]; then exec "$r/.agents/hooks/tms-doc-sync-stop.sh"; elif [ -x "$HOME/.agents/hooks/tms-doc-sync-stop.sh" ]; then exec "$HOME/.agents/hooks/tms-doc-sync-stop.sh"; fi; printf "{}"'
